verdict.rationale: Luma offers a public API, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt file, markdown versions of doc pages and the SDKs are adjacent features and are not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
